fileAfter.summary: [BE] KPI "last unit cost" drops a zero-cost movement — kpi.repository

text.description:
## Summary

When an incoming movement has unit cost 0, the KPI last unit cost is not set to 0. It keeps the previous value. The same happens for last unit price when an outgoing movement has price 0.

## Environment

Env: local

## Steps to reproduce

1. A product has a prior KPI row with last_cost = 50.
2. Ingest an incoming movement for that product with unit cost = 0.
3. Read the product's KPI last unit cost.

## Expected

The KPI last unit cost is 0.

## Actual

The KPI last unit cost is 50. The 0 is ignored.

## Acceptance criteria

Given a product with last cost = 50  
When I save a movement with cost = 0  
Then the last cost is 0
